purpose: Convert external football-state changes into one normalized append-only event ledger that can trigger downstream connected-impact reassessment without directly setting ranks, projections or betting decisions.

primary_automated: ESPN public NFL team roster endpoint
ESPN public NFL team depth-chart endpoint
ESPN public NFL team injury endpoint
source_hierarchy.market_source: The Odds API v4 is excluded from football-event causation and remains downstream market comparison only

prohibitions: Event ingestion may not write Overall rank, True-Value rank, season projection, weekly projection, market-value label or betting recommendation.
Sportsbook movement may not be classified as the cause of a football-state change.
Missing source rows may not be interpreted as ACTIVE, RELEASED or REMOVED.
A detected event may trigger downstream recalculation but may not dictate the downstream answer.
